thread:
Sam (PM): quick sync — we need a decision by EOD on the 'wedge' approach for the v1 milestone. do we cut detailed telemetry from MVP and ship a thin telemetry shim, or keep full metrics for launch?
Riya (Eng Lead): my vote is thin shim for MVP. heavy telemetry adds backend work + schema polish that will slip the integration. we can implement an event passthrough and mark detailed hooks for v1.
Tomas (CS): Acme and BetaCorp explicitly asked for audit logs. if we remove detailed telemetry from MVP, we need a clear comms plan and a temporary support process.
Marta (Design): UX-wise we can hide advanced analytics behind a beta flag. customers won't lose core flows. will need copy for feature matrix and release notes.
Leo (SRE): big +1 for the shim. also: if we keep a minimal event shape, we can route to a cheaper retention tier and avoid pushing our observability costs. SLO impact should be minimal.
Riya (Eng Lead): proposed minimal event schema (RFC-lite):
```
{ "evt": "user_request", "ts": <iso>, "model": "x", "latency_ms": 123 }
```
This is lightweight and supports basic regression checks.
Sam (PM): ok that helps. what about rollout gating? can we ship MVP with shim and enable detailed telemetry per-customer behind an opt-in?
Tomas (CS): yes, but for Acme we need audit trail now. propose a targeted contract addendum: ship shim for general GA, enable enhanced telemetry for Acme via enterprise toggle + migration support.
Marta (Design): will draft the UI flag and the admin control copy.
Riya (Eng Lead): timeline: shim + server hook + flag = 3 dev sprints. detailed pipeline + dashboards = additional 2 sprints. can we move some telemetry dashboard work to the Optimize backlog post-v1?
Sam (PM): sounds reasonable. launch criteria for MVP then: 1) core inference API stability, 2) basic cost/latency telemetry (shim), 3) admin flag for enterprise toggles, 4) SRE sanity checks green. anything else?
Leo (SRE): add: runbook for degraded telemetry + fallback to mock events. also a quick alert for sudden drop in event volume.
Tomas (CS): I'll prepare the customer comms template and contract wording for Acme.
Riya (Eng Lead): I'll add the shim tickets and mark dependent dashboard work as v1. tagging owners now.
release-bot: deploy plan updated: feature-branch -> canary on staging on 1755554600, GA candidate target 1755559000.
Sam (PM): decision recorded: cut heavy telemetry from MVP, ship thin shim + enterprise opt-in for enhanced telemetry. follow-ups: Riya to own implementation, Marta to own admin UI, Tomas to own customer comms. thanks :thumbsup:
Marta (Design): noted. will post mockups in #design later today.
Riya (Eng Lead): ping me if anyone needs the event schema extended.
Tomas (CS): will loop Acme PM.
Sam (PM): end of thread — will update the milestone doc and the release checklist after sync.
